result.topic_en: Contiguous relations of the hypergeometric series F(α,β,γ) and the continued-fraction expansions of ratios of contiguous hypergeometric functions derived from them, with the special case α = 0.
result.transcription:
$F(\alpha-1,\beta+1,\gamma) - F(\alpha,\beta,\gamma) = \frac{(\alpha-\beta-1)x}{\gamma} F(\alpha,\beta+1,\gamma+1)$

[36] $F(\alpha,\beta+1,\gamma+1) - F(\alpha,\beta,\gamma) = \frac{\alpha(\gamma-\beta)x}{\gamma.\gamma+1} F(\alpha+1,\beta+1,\gamma+2)$
[37] $F(\alpha+1,\beta,\gamma+1) - F(\alpha,\beta,\gamma) = \frac{\beta(\gamma-\alpha)x}{\gamma.\gamma+1} F(\alpha+1,\beta+1,\gamma+2)$
[38] $F(\alpha-1,\beta+1,\gamma) - F(\alpha+1,\beta-1,\gamma) = \frac{(\alpha-\beta)x}{\gamma} F(\alpha+1,\beta+1,\gamma+1)$
Aus der Verbindung von 36 und 37 folgt

[39] $\frac{F(\alpha,\beta+1,\gamma+1)}{F(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)} = \cfrac{1}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{\alpha(\gamma-\beta)x}{\gamma.\gamma+1}}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{(\beta+1)(\gamma+1-\alpha)x}{\gamma+1.\gamma+2}}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{(\alpha+1)(\gamma+1-\beta)x}{\gamma+2.\gamma+3}}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{(\beta+2)(\gamma+2-\alpha)x}{\gamma+3.\gamma+4}}{1 - \&c.}}}}}$

[40] $\frac{F(\alpha+1,\beta,\gamma)}{F(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)} = \cfrac{1}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{\beta x}{\gamma}}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{(\alpha+1)(\gamma-\beta)x}{\gamma.\gamma+1}}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{(\beta+1)(\gamma-\alpha)x}{\gamma+1.\gamma+2}}{1 - \frac{(\alpha+2)(\gamma+1-\beta)x}{\gamma+2.\gamma+3}\ \text{etc.}}}}}$

Also für $\alpha = 0$
[41] $1 + \frac{\beta}{\gamma}x + \frac{\beta.\beta+1}{\gamma.\gamma+1}xx + \frac{\beta.\beta+1.\beta+2}{\gamma.\gamma+1.\gamma+2}x^3 + \&c.$
$= \cfrac{1}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{\beta}{\gamma}x}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{2(\gamma-\beta)}{\gamma.\gamma+1}x}{1 - \cfrac{\frac{(\beta+1)\gamma}{\gamma+1.\gamma+2}x}{1 - \frac{3(\gamma+1-\beta)}{\gamma+2.\gamma+3}x\ \text{etc.}}}}}$
